dialect.detail: Likely GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) targeting a PC/Linux environment with indexed files on DISK, SCREEN SECTION, LOCK MODE IS MANUAL, and Portuguese-language identifiers. Could also be Micro Focus or ACU on PC, but GnuCOBOL is most consistent with the feature set and open-source context.

purpose.domain_detail: Customer and salesperson registration system for a company called 'EMPRESA INSTALACOES S.A.', managing client (CNPJ, razao social, latitude/longitude) and vendor records with CSV export capability.
purpose.summary: A menu-driven interactive COBOL program that manages customer and salesperson records stored in indexed files. It provides options for registration (create/update/delete), reporting, and execution, with a full-screen TUI using the SCREEN SECTION. The program handles client records including geolocation (latitude/longitude) and CNPJ (Brazilian tax ID).

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with full TUI (BACKGROUND-COLOR, FOREGROUND-COLOR, LINE/COL positioning)
Indexed file I/O with ALTERNATE RECORD KEY (CNPJ)
LOCK MODE IS MANUAL on indexed files
VALUE OF FILE-ID for file assignment
ACCEPT ... UPPER AT nnnn for uppercase input
COPY copybooks for CLIENTE and VENDEDOR record layouts
